authoring.summary: Mechanon Ascens 03 maintains its machine storm while interrupting it with three red-flashing fast-asteroid barrages.
generation_notes: The executable timeline is hand-authored; keep phase patterns empty to prevent duplicate compiler spawns.
Preserve the existing 0.9-second drone cadence between injected flashing phases.
Replace each original asteroid with a three-shot cardinal burst at 0.12-second spacing and move_speed 390.

Each flashing phase has one empty second before and after it and equalizes travel time so spawn gaps are preserved at player arrival while every asteroid starts at the normal arena margin. Phase 1 fires every 0.3 seconds, phase 2 every 0.25 seconds, and phase 3 every 0.2 seconds. Every phase uses all eight cardinal and diagonal directions from 0 through 315 degrees in 45-degree increments, and no direction may repeat either of the previous two entries. The background transitions gradually between red and black every 0.2 seconds and fades back to black before normal gameplay resumes.
